description: In `return match (a, b) { … }` a braced arm that writes then `return`s leaves the function (S462 review F2); a `break` of a loop INSIDE a value block arm is that loop's, not a leave of the match (F5); a `?` arm of a multi-scrutinee statement or decl match propagates (F7).
rationale: §19.4.3: an arm LEAVES when it ends in `return` / `fail` on every path; a `break` that targets a loop inside the arm never crosses the arm boundary. §19.5.2: `?` returns the error from the enclosing function.
